Actual Chromium original: four states (inactive, paused, camera change, Load) each replaced the text child 12 times across 12 animation frames. Source port: 3 RED/3 legal. The narrow producer guard retains identical localized text only; viewport/canvas/session/routing unchanged. Detached actual unconditional-assignment mutation returns 3 RED/3 controls; finally byte-exact restore SHA256 458d831398bd9d101e1e44838e56886cd223cc4e1bebfaf62302c205a8658766, source diff zero. Restored 24 controls/3 files, app/tools strict types and production build GREEN.

Actual fixed Chromium run: inactive, paused, changed camera viewport all preserve firstChild, zero replacements. This is partial consumer evidence, NOT an overall native pass: both runs then hit my fixture protocol error trying the language button inside a closed Settings menu. Initial inference that Load removed the control was false; source audit confirms public Settings must be opened and language deliberately saves/reloads (ADR0119). Original errors and exact executed fixtures retained. Current public Settings/reload recipe is corrected offline but not executed. No retries or hidden browser reruns; lease released. No CPU/latency/hosted CI claim.
